photo.credit: NASA · NERVA (Nuclear Engine for Rocket Vehicle Application) XE-Prime engine on the test stand at Jackass Flats, Nevada, c. 1969. The NERVA/Rover programme conducted 22 reactor tests between 1959 and 1972, demonstrating specific impulses above 800 seconds — more than double the best chemical engines of the era. No nuclear thermal engine has flown.
